fusions.name: Sluice Gate
fusions.desc: Releases a torrent ahead of you, which deals 28 damage to everything within 4.5 tiles in front and leaves each enemy [Soaked] for 8 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Slate Skip
fusions.desc: Skims a slate at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Waterproof Render
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Drip Mould
fusions.desc: Each affliction laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.
